materialAnalysisExtracted: New England has a healthy Drake Maye plus A.J. Brown and Romeo Doubs upgrades; Seattle is missing multiple players from the Super Bowl defense, including Riq Woolen, Boye Mafe and Coby Bryant, while Kenneth Walker is also gone. Sharp expects Brown to be featured and sees Rashid Shaheed's new contract/new coordinator as evidence of broader short/intermediate usage. Sept. 13 recheck found three newly completed constructions. Buffalo's rebuilt defensive system/secondary and Houston regression case support the offense-over stack; Chicago's weak pass rush and depleted secondary support the Carolina passing stack; Dallas' thin backfield and New York's defensive-coordinator/game-environment changes support the Cowboys-Giants under plus Williams workload.
dedupeCrossCheck: Cross-checked nfl-expert-weekly.json using source family + canonical game ID + analyst + construction/detail. No existing Sharp record represented this three-leg SGP; the prior Sharp touchdown-scorer rows are different constructions and were preserved.
gameIdCrossCheck: Patriots-Seahawks matched canonical nfl-weekly-board game ID 2bf1ca8d-11d6-4c00-b2e4-28971764e444. No unmatched record was written.
expertLedgerWrite: One comprehensive SGP record appended to data/nfl-expert-weekly.json; the three legs were not split into artificial independent confirmations.
quantitativeGovernance: No NFL fair spread, total, confidence, market state or official wager status was modified.
finalCompletenessAudit: COMPLETE for all currently published Week 1 constructions visible on the official page as of Sept. 13.
